WITH filtered_enrollment AS (
    SELECT f.`School Code`, f.`Charter Funding Type`, s.`AdmEmail1`, f.`Enrollment (K-12)`
    FROM frpm AS f
    INNER JOIN schools AS s ON f.`CDSCode` = s.`CDSCode`
    WHERE f.`Charter School (Y/N)` = 1 AND f.`Enrollment (K-12)` IS NOT NULL
),
min_students AS (
    SELECT MIN(fe.`Enrollment (K-12)`) AS min_enroll
    FROM filtered_enrollment AS fe
)
SELECT fe.`AdmEmail1`
FROM filtered_enrollment AS fe
JOIN min_students AS ms ON fe.`Enrollment (K-12)` = ms.min_enroll;	----- bird -----	california_schools

WITH avg_scores AS (
    SELECT 
        ss.cds, 
        (ss.AvgScrMath + ss.AvgScrRead + ss.AvgScrWrite) / 3 AS avg_score,
        sc.County
    FROM 
        satscores AS ss
    INNER JOIN 
        schools AS sc ON ss.cds = sc.CDSCode
),
min_avg_score AS (
    SELECT MIN(avg_score) AS min_avg
    FROM avg_scores
)
SELECT 
    av.avg_score, 
    av.County
FROM 
    avg_scores av
JOIN 
    min_avg_score mas ON av.avg_score = mas.min_avg;	----- bird -----	california_schools

WITH c_cols AS (
    SELECT cl.client_id, cl.gender, dt.A11 AS avg_salary
    FROM client AS cl
    JOIN district AS dt ON cl.district_id = dt.district_id
    WHERE cl.gender = 'F'
),
c_rows AS (
    SELECT client_id, AVG(avg_salary) AS avg_sal
    FROM c_cols
    GROUP BY client_id
)
SELECT cc.client_id, cc.avg_salary
FROM c_cols cc
JOIN c_rows cr ON cc.client_id = cr.client_id
WHERE cc.avg_salary = cr.avg_sal
ORDER BY cc.avg_salary ASC, cc.client_id ASC;	----- bird -----	financial

WITH major_bond AS (
    SELECT bond_type, COUNT(*) AS count
    FROM bond
    WHERE molecule_id = 'TR010'
    GROUP BY bond_type
    ORDER BY count DESC
    LIMIT 1
),
carcinogenicity AS (
    SELECT CASE WHEN EXISTS (
        SELECT 1 FROM molecule WHERE molecule_id = 'TR010' AND label LIKE '%carcinogenic%'
    ) THEN 'Yes' ELSE 'No' END AS is_carcinogenic
)
SELECT mb.bond_type, cb.is_carcinogenic
FROM major_bond mb
CROSS JOIN carcinogenicity cb;	----- bird -----	toxicology
